title: 3 horas de hunt. Ele mandou uma foto... e uma legenda
concept: A real customer message told as a film: inside a 2.39:1 letterbox, '3 horas de hunt', 13:15 he sends a photo, 'repara no Pokémon Center'; then the bars open and the caption lands as evidence: 'Pega esse doublé smeargle 7 ai / 3h de hunt' = two Smeargle 7.

notes: Deviation for truth: the concept's hook 'Ele saiu por 3 horas' / 'Deixou o char numa hunt. Fechou a porta.' adds facts the print doesn't state (it only says '3h de hunt').
